name: smarts-claude-manager
description: Patch Claude Code with finegrained UI settings for font sizes, code blocks, diff cards, and more.

smartsClaudeManager.patchEnabled.markdownDescription: Whether the patch is applied. "Fully Disable Patch" sets this to `false` (and reverts Claude Code to native); "Enable Patch" sets it back to `true` (and re-applies your saved settings).

smartsClaudeManager.chatHistoryFontSize.markdownDescription: Chat font size in px, private to Claude Code so other chat panels are unaffected. `0` follows `#chat.fontSize#`.

smartsClaudeManager.chatHistoryFontFamil.markdownDescription: Font family for the chat history only; the interface and input box stay native. Empty = native.

smartsClaudeManager.userMessageFontSize.markdownDescription: Your own prompt bubble text size in px (the user-message body only; the agent response is sized separately by `#smartsClaudeManager.chatHistoryFontSize#`). `0` = native (inherit `#chat.fontSize#`).

smartsClaudeManager.chatCodeblockFontSiz.markdownDescription: Chat fenced code block size in px.

smartsClaudeManager.chatCodeInlineFontSi.markdownDescription: Chat inline code size in px. `0` follows `#smartsClaudeManager.chatCodeblockFontSize#`.

smartsClaudeManager.chatComposerFontSize.markdownDescription: Chat message input box (composer) text size in px.

smartsClaudeManager.chatDiffCardFontSize.markdownDescription: Diff card code size in px (Edit/MultiEdit cards and the expand modal).

smartsClaudeManager.chatDiffCardLineNumb.markdownDescription: Show line numbers in the diff card, with real `+`/`-` gutter signs.

smartsClaudeManager.chatDiffCardThemeSyn.markdownDescription: Sync the diff card theme to the VS Code light/dark theme instead of forcing dark.

smartsClaudeManager.chatPermissionCodeMa.markdownDescription: Size the permission command block to match the tool input block (`0.85em` instead of `0.9em`).

smartsClaudeManager.chatShowMoreAndLessA.markdownDescription: Pin the chat message "Show more" and "Show less" buttons to a side. Empty = native (drifting) position; `left` or `right` places them deterministically.

smartsClaudeManager.effortSyncFix.markdownDescription: On window reload, push the persisted effort level to the CLI so it does not silently run at the default.

smartsClaudeManager.planPreviewFontSize.markdownDescription: Plan preview text size in px (headings scale with it).

smartsClaudeManager.planPreviewFontFamil.markdownDescription: Font family for the Plan Mode preview panel. Empty = native.

smartsClaudeManager.planPreviewCodeblock.markdownDescription: Plan preview fenced code block size in px.

smartsClaudeManager.planPreviewCodeInlin.markdownDescription: Plan preview inline code size in px. `0` follows `#smartsClaudeManager.planPreviewCodeblockFontSize#`.

smartsClaudeManager.planPreviewCommentIn.markdownDescription: Plan preview comment box text size in px.
Plan preview comment box height in rows. `0` = native (about 3).

smartsClaudeManager.planPreviewCommentQu.markdownDescription: Plan preview selected-quote size in px.

smartsClaudeManager.planPreviewCommentBa.markdownDescription: Plan preview comment badge size in px (14px circle, keep <= 12).

smartsClaudeManager.chatHideUsageWarning.markdownDescription: Permanently hide the "You've used X% of your weekly limit" usage banner and its "View usage" link, instead of it reappearing after each dismissal.

smartsClaudeManager.autoContinueQuietMs.markdownDescription: AutoContinue: how long (ms) an error/rate-limit banner must sit with no new message before "continue" is auto-submitted.

smartsClaudeManager.autoContinueCooldown.markdownDescription: AutoContinue: minimum gap (ms) between two auto-submitted "continue" messages.

smartsClaudeManager.autoContinueDefaultC.markdownDescription: AutoContinue: maximum number of auto-submitted "continue" messages per session.

smartsClaudeManager.draftSaveStaleMs.markdownDescription: DraftSave: a saved draft older than this (ms) is treated as expired and never restored. Default 600000 = 10 minutes.

smartsClaudeManager.draftSaveDebounceMs.markdownDescription: DraftSave: how long (ms) after you stop typing before the composer's draft text is saved.

smartsClaudeManager.feature.reply.markdownDescription: Reply on selection: quote selected chat text into the prompt input.

smartsClaudeManager.feature.googlesearch.markdownDescription: Add "Search on Google" to the right-click menu for selected chat text.

smartsClaudeManager.feature.search.markdownDescription: Chat Search (Ctrl+F): find text within the chat.

smartsClaudeManager.feature.datetime.markdownDescription: Date/time stamps on chat messages, with day separators.

smartsClaudeManager.feature.userstyle.markdownDescription: Restyle user messages as a distinct bubble.

smartsClaudeManager.feature.blockquote.markdownDescription: Restyle Markdown blockquote callouts (and tool-interrupt notices).

smartsClaudeManager.feature.copybuttons.markdownDescription: Per-message date/time + Copy as Markdown/HTML buttons. Requires `#smartsClaudeManager.feature.datetime#`.

smartsClaudeManager.feature.multiselect.markdownDescription: A checkbox on each assistant reply's Copy row plus a toolbar action to batch-copy every checked reply as one Markdown or HTML block (shift-click for HTML). Requires `#smartsClaudeManager.feature.copybuttons#`.

smartsClaudeManager.feature.codeblock.markdownDescription: A Copy button on every fenced code block.

smartsClaudeManager.feature.toc.markdownDescription: Outline panel: jump to any earlier prompt.

smartsClaudeManager.feature.export.markdownDescription: Export the whole chat to Markdown, HTML, or the clipboard.

smartsClaudeManager.feature.scroll.markdownDescription: Toolbar buttons to jump to the first/latest message.

smartsClaudeManager.feature.usercollapse.markdownDescription: Add an "Expand message"/"Collapse message" item to the native "Message actions" popup on long user messages.

smartsClaudeManager.feature.autocontinue.markdownDescription: Automatically submit "continue" when a stream-error banner appears.

smartsClaudeManager.feature.draftsave.markdownDescription: Autosave and restore the composer's draft text per chat.

smartsClaudeManager.feature.noarrowuphis.markdownDescription: Disable pressing ArrowUp in an empty composer to recall your last sent message (Claude Code's own native behavior).

smartsClaudeManager.feature.usernav.markdownDescription: Toolbar buttons to jump between your own messages.

smartsClaudeManager.feature.forkconv.markdownDescription: A "Fork conversation" icon button to the left of each of your own messages, forking the chat from that message.

smartsClaudeManager.feature.forkincopy.markdownDescription: Also add a "Fork conversation" icon button to the Copy row on each assistant reply, forking from that reply's preceding message. Requires `#smartsClaudeManager.feature.copybuttons#`.

smartsClaudeManager.feature.faro.markdownDescription: Ship chat-enhancement feature diagnostics to Grafana Cloud (console + Loki via Faro). Unchecking silences logging everywhere immediately, with no reload. Only a feature that is itself checked ON logs anything, even while this is checked ON.

smartsClaudeManager.feature.filelinks.markdownDescription: Make a file path shown as inline code (relative or absolute) clickable — opens it in a real editor tab.

smartsClaudeManager.feature.modelinfo.markdownDescription: Show the running model's name/version as the composer's placeholder text before you type (disappears automatically once you start typing).

smartsClaudeManager.feature.effortinfo.markdownDescription: Show the running effort level and thinking status as the composer's placeholder text before you type (disappears automatically once you start typing).
